Vacancy Listing Dates 22/07/2026 to 19/08/2026
Please Quote Reference Number 17702
- Multiple positions available

- Join the team at Ahrens Mining & Industrial Services

Ahrens Mining & Industrial Services was established over 30 years ago. During this time, the company has gained an outstanding reputation for supplying welding and fabrication services to the petro-chemical and mining industry within the state of Western Australia.

The company employs over 100 highly skilled employees as boilermakers, pipe fitters and welders, with over 35 years of experience in the construction industry. This dedicated workforce includes a technical support team, ensuring all projects are handled in a professional manner without compromising quality, safety or the environment.

We are seeking experienced Full time and Casual Welders, Pipe Fitters, Metal Fabricators, Mechanical Fitters, Electronic Instrument Maintenance Technicians, Pressure Welders, Sheet Metal Workers, Metal Machinists, Mechanical Engineering Technicians, Boilermakers, Painters, Mechanical Engineers and Carpenters to join our team for Workshop and Site Work.

Welders, Pipe Fitters, Metal Fabricators, Mechanical Fitters, Mechanical Engineers, and Carpenters must be experienced in both construction and maintenance projects. Pressure Welders must be experienced in welding and repairing pipes. Mechanical Engineers must have a relevant Bachelors degree and a minimum of 3 years work experience.

Equipment repairs include:
- Lathes
- Flange facing
- Pipe Beveller
- CNC

Salary $78,000 - $85,000.

Minimum Requirement:
- Trade Certificate
- Experience working within this industry
- Must pass a Medical and Drug Screen
- Be reliable, punctual and hard working
- Clear understanding of Safety Regulations & Safe Work Practices

Highly Desirable:
 -Working at Heights
- Confined Space
- Elevated Work Platform

We are also seeking experienced Production and Mechanical Engineers to join our team and carry out the coordination of design, construction and maintenance of equipment and machines.

Responsibilities of this role include:
- Read and interpret drawings and specifications to determine job requirements
 -Inspect and monitor plant equipment as required
- Participate in shift/swing hand over prior to finishing work to ensure other employees are aware of all relevant information
- Project information to determine functions and responsibilities of workers to identify areas of duplication and ensure labour utilisation is at maximum capacity
- Analyse operational data, production schedules and costs to determine optimum worker and equipment efficiencies
- Seek continuous improvement, develop new skills, and promote efficiency
- Familiarize with policies, safety, and reporting systems for compliance
- Establishing standards and policies for installation, modification, quality control, testing, inspection and maintenance according to engineering principles and safety regulations
- Carrying out inspections to ensure optimum performance is maintained
- Directing the maintenance and coordinating the requirements for new designs, surveys and maintenance schedules,
- Undertake all other reasonable tasks and duties that are peripheral to your role and within your skill and ability, as directed

Essential Skills & Experience:
 -Bachelor's degree or higher qualification
- Previous experience in a similar role
- Demonstrated attention to detail
- Ability to work independently under minimal supervision

Salary $100,000 - $120,000

We are also looking for a Fitter & Turner to join our team. Duties will include:
 -Studying drawings and specifications to determine materials, methods, and machine settings 
- Cutting, grinding, shaping and machining metal and other materials using specialised machinery and tools
- Setting up and adjusting metalworking machines and equipment 
- Fitting fabricated metal parts and assembling mechanical components and subassemblies into machinery and equipment
- Checking finished parts for accuracy, clearance and fit using precision measuring instruments
- Maintaining, diagnosing faults and repairing mechanical machinery and equipment 
- Operating machines such as lathes, milling machines, drills, grinders, and related metalworking equipment

Essential Skills & Experience:

- Previous experience in a similar role
- Demonstrated attention to detail
- Ability to work independently under minimal supervision

Join a highly respected Australian defence technology organisation delivering complex engineering programs that support critical national capabilities. With a strong focus on innovation and project excellence, this organisation offers the opportunity to contribute to the delivery of sophisticated, software-intensive systems within a highly collaborative environment.  
  Role Description     
  As the Configuration Management Officer, you will be responsible for planning, executing, and maintaining CM activities across the full project lifecycle. Acting as the primary point of contact for CM-related matters, you will ensure configuration control processes are effectively implemented and maintained while supporting engineering, project, and IT teams.  
  Key Responsibilities  
 
  Execute and maintain CM activities across all project stages, recording and maintaining product hierarchies and identifiers within baseline documentation.  
  Act as Secretary to the Configuration Control Board (CCB), circulating paperwork, scheduling meetings, and ensuring change processes are successfully completed.  
  Maintain a detailed inventory of assets, including operating system versions, patch statuses, and installed applications.  
  Collaborate with IT and administration staff to maintain and improve the CM system, including library environments, access privileges, and backups.  
  Establish requirements for supplier delivery of data products, document timely receipts, and assess data acceptability.  
  Perform physical and functional audits of systems and software to verify compliance with established baselines, providing input to the Quality Manager.  
 
  Key Skills & Attributes  
 
  Configuration & Data Management: Deep functional knowledge of CM and Data Management principles and their associated tools.  
  IT & Engineering Acumen: Proficiency in IT combined with a solid understanding of project and engineering management lifecycles.  
  Analytical Problem-Solving: A structured and analytical approach to problem identification and resolution.  
  Meticulous Precision: Exceptional attention to detail when planning and performing all configuration tasks.  
  Communication & Collaboration: The ability to communicate clearly and concisely, working effectively on your own, within the team, and with external agencies or subcontractors.  
 
  Qualifications & Experience  
 
  Security Clearance: Must hold an active NV1 Australian Defence security clearance or have the ability to obtain one.  
  Experience: 2+ years of experience using mature/commercial CM tools within an engineering lifecycle environment.  
  Technical Exposure: 2+ years of experience supporting the delivery of complex systems containing software.  
  Education: A Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science, IT, or a related field is highly regarded, alongside prior Defence Industry experience.  
 
  Why Join?   Secure a rewarding opportunity to work on complex Defence projects within a supportive and technically focused environment. You will have the chance to further develop your Configuration Management expertise while contributing to critical sovereign capability programs.  
  How to Apply  
  If you have the experience to execute these critical CM functions and meet the security requirements, please apply now with your updated resume.  
 If this role sounds enticing to you, please do not hesitate to apply now or send Rohan an email at Rohan.cantleysmith@randstad.com.au.

result.description:
Lead reliability at one of Australia's largest food manufacturing facilities!

At JBS Dinmore, the largest and most respected beef processing plants in the southern hemisphere, we are seeking an experienced Maintenance Superintendent to join our Maintenance Leadership Team.

Reporting to the Engineering Manager, you will be responsible for overseeing all maintenance activities within the abattoir, ensuring equipment reliability, compliance with WHS standards, and minimal downtime. This role manages maintenance teams, coordinates preventive and corrective maintenance, and supports continuous improvement initiatives to optimise plant performance This is a full-time role with annual salary higher than $120,000 plus Superannuation.

Key Responsibilities

· Plan, schedule, and supervise preventive and corrective maintenance activities.

· Ensure compliance with WHS, environmental, and food safety standards during maintenance operations.

· Manage maintenance team performance, rosters, and resource allocation.

· Monitor equipment reliability and implement strategies to reduce downtime.

· Coordinate with Production, QA, and Engineering to resolve technical issues promptly.

· Maintain accurate records of maintenance activities, spare parts usage, and equipment history.

· Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance maintenance efficiency and cost-effectiveness.

· Ensure compliance with statutory inspections and regulatory requirements.

· Support capital projects and installation of new equipment.

· Encourage open communication so staff feel comfortable reporting hazards, equipment issues, or training needs.

· Reinforce teamwork between maintenance, operations, and QA, helping everyone understand the impact of their role on plant performance and food safety.

· Serve as a trusted point of contact for technical questions, offering approachable and supportive guidance.

· Additional tasks as requested by your supervisor or management.

About You

· Extensive experience in industrial maintenance within food processing or manufacturing.

· Strong knowledge of mechanical, electrical, and refrigeration systems.

· Understanding of WHS, environmental, and food safety compliance.

· Leadership and team management skills.

· Ability to analyse data and implement reliability improvement strategies.

· Trade qualification or engineering degree.

· Experience with CMMS (Computerised Maintenance Management Systems).

· Knowledge of Lean or continuous improvement methodologies.

Why Join JBS?

Leadership opportunity within Australia's largest food manufacturer
Influence reliability and maintenance strategy across a major production facility
Work with large-scale industrial equipment and modern automation systems
Ongoing professional development and career progression opportunities
Supportive leadership team and stable, long-term employment
If you're an experienced electrical leader ready to make a significant impact in a complex manufacturing environment, we'd love to hear from you.

The Ad is valid for 28 days.

Apply now and help drive operational excellence at JBS Dinmore.

Workshop boilermaker role focused on fabrication, crane builds and precision assembly with a 9-day fortnight    Your new company  Our client is a well-established engineering and fabrication business with a strong reputation for delivering high-quality steel products and crane solutions. Operating a modern workshop environment, they pride themselves on precision workmanship, safety, and delivering complex projects to exacting standards.   Your new role  In this position, you will be based in the workshop, completing high-quality fabrication, welding, and assembly work. You will be involved in the build of crane beams and hoists, including full fabrication, mechanical fit-out, and testing. The role requires working from engineering drawings to tight tolerances, ensuring accuracy and compliance with specifications. You will also undertake a variety of tasks including machining, cutting, bending, rolling, grinding, drilling, and assembling steel components.   What you'll need to succeed  
 
 Trade qualified Boilermaker 
 Strong fabrication experience in a workshop environment 
 Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings independently 
 Experience working to tight tolerances and specifications 
 Competency across fabrication processes including cutting, bending, rolling and assembly 
 High attention to detail and commitment to quality workmanship 
 Ability to complete a pre-employment medical & Police Check 
 Ability to work both autonomously and within a team 
 
  What you'll get in return  You will secure a role with a respected and stable company offering consistent workshop-based work and a strong focus on fabrication. The position provides a competitive casual rate of $58.06 plus overtime penalties, along with the benefit of a 9-day fortnight supporting work-life balance. This is an excellent opportunity to further develop your fabrication skills on specialised projects in a well-equipped workshop environment.   What you need to do now  If you're interested in this role, applications can be submitted via the "apply now" button. Please ensure you are submitting an up-to-date CV. ## Cyber Security Advice and Assessment Specialist
## Position Overview
We are looking for a skilled and detail-oriented Cyber Security Advice and Assessment Specialist to join our team and play a pivotal role in safeguarding our organisation's information assets and digital infrastructure. This position is responsible for conducting security assessments, interpreting policies, and delivering expert guidance on cyber security strategies and risk management. The ideal candidate brings a strong technical foundation combined with the ability to communicate complex security concepts to a broad range of stakeholders. This role suits a proactive professional who thrives in dynamic environments and is committed to continuously strengthening an organisation's security posture.
## Key Responsibilities
- Conduct comprehensive risk assessments and security control evaluations to identify vulnerabilities and weaknesses across the organisation's systems, networks, and cyber security policies
- Perform vulnerability testing and threat analysis, translating findings into actionable recommendations that reduce exposure and strengthen overall defences
- Provide specialist advice and practical guidance on security strategies, helping stakeholders understand and effectively manage identified risks and emerging threats
- Develop, implement, and maintain security policies, standards, procedures, and guidelines that support a robust and consistent organisational security posture
- Lead and support investigations into security incidents, producing clear and thorough reports on findings and guiding the refinement of detection and response processes
- Assist with root cause analysis following security incidents or breaches, assessing the extent of impact and recommending appropriate remedial and preventative actions
- Review and assess information system designs to ensure security requirements are embedded throughout development and implementation lifecycles
- Develop and maintain meaningful metrics and reporting frameworks that articulate the impact of cyber security risks on business processes and information assets
- Align and coordinate internal and external audit activities, security assessments, and compliance engagements to ensure consistent and efficient outcomes
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to embed security best practices across business operations and technology initiatives
- Communicate complex security concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences, providing guidance that enables informed decision-making at all levels of the organisation
## Required Qualifications & Skills
- Bachelor's degree in Cyber Security, Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related discipline
- Demonstrated experience in a cyber security role with a focus on risk assessment, security advisory, or security operations
- Strong working knowledge of security frameworks and standards such as ISO 27001, NIST, ASD Essential Eight, or equivalent
- Proven ability to conduct vulnerability assessments, penetration testing coordination, and security control reviews
- Experience developing and implementing security policies, standards, and procedures within a complex organisational environment
- Solid understanding of network security, cloud security principles, identity and access management, and secure system design
- Experience investigating and reporting on security incidents, including root cause analysis and post-incident remediation
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to assess risk and prioritise effectively
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to produce clear reports and present findings to diverse audiences
- Familiarity with audit coordination and compliance assessment processes across regulatory or industry frameworks
- Ability to work both autonomously and collaboratively within a multidisciplinary team
## Preferred Qualifications
- Relevant industry certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CISA, CompTIA Security+, or CEH
- Experience working within Australian Government security frameworks or with protective security requirements
- Familiarity with the Australian Signals Directorate (ASD) guidelines and the Information Security Manual (ISM)
- Postgraduate qualifications in Cyber Security, Risk Management, or a related field
- Experience with security information and event management (SIEM) platforms or other security tooling
- Prior exposure to governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) platforms or tools
## Why Join Us?
- Be part of a collaborative and forward-thinking team that values innovation, continuous learning, and genuine contribution to meaningful security outcomes
- Access ongoing professional development opportunities, including support for industry certifications and training programmes
- Enjoy a flexible working environment that supports work-life balance through hybrid arrangements and adaptable scheduling
- Contribute to high-impact work that directly protects critical systems and supports the organisation's strategic objectives
- Competitive remuneration package with clear pathways for career growth and advancement within the cyber security function
## Job Details
- Job Type: Full-time, Permanent
- Work Schedule: 8-hour shift
- Salary: $70,000 – $120,000 per year + Super
